name: Motorized Scooter
description: A vehicle with no more than three wheels, handlebars and a foot support or seat, whose electric power source the manufacturer has programmed not to exceed 35 mph on level ground. It sets no wattage cap, so a speed-limited electric two-wheeler can fall here whatever its motor. Defined by 47 O.S. §1-133.3.
restrictions: No more than three wheels, handlebars, and a foot support or seat
An electric power source programmed by the manufacturer not to exceed 35 mph on level ground; the definition sets no wattage cap
Electric-assisted bicycles, motorized bicycles and electric personal assistive mobility devices are excluded
Riders must be 14 or older unless a local ordinance sets an older age
No driver's license or insurance needed unless a local ordinance requires one
May not be ridden faster than 25 mph, or on any roadway posted over 25 mph
Riders under 16 may not carry passengers; older riders may carry one only on a factory double seat with footrests and wheels at least 12 inches in diameter
May not pass other vehicles between lanes of traffic
Cities and counties may regulate where it's ridden on roads, trails, sidewalks and other public spaces
